LIFE SKILLS ACTIVITY 10 · CLASS 32 · AGES 4–5

Help at Home

Chores matched to their tools, kind helping hands and one job you can really do.

THE ACTIVITY — WRITE AND DRAW RIGHT ON THE SHEET

Your sheet is ready.

Pick a color or the eraser, then circle, match, trace and draw straight on the sheet with your finger, a stylus or the mouse. Press Save my work when you are proud — that is what marks this activity cleared for your child.

← Stay SafePrevious activityCare for Plants →Next activity
HOW TO DO IT

Five little steps.

  1. 1

    Circle

    Find the child busy helping at home — circle them.

  2. 2

    Match

    Draw a line from each chore to the tool it needs.

  3. 3

    Choose

    Two children want the same toy — tick the one showing helpful behaviour.

  4. 4

    Trace

    Trace the words HELP AT HOME, nice and big.

  5. 5

    Draw

    Draw one job you can really do at your house.

Ask a grown-up to read the steps aloud the first time. After that, you know just what to do.

YOUR PENCIL CASE

Pick your tools.

Pencil, nine crayons, an eraser, undo, redo and clear — the tools appear right here and work on the sheet. Save keeps your finished work as a picture.

MY PROGRESS

Save it to keep it.

This activity is cleared for you the moment you save your finished sheet. Nothing counts until then — opening the page is just opening the door.

Cleared! Your saved work for this sheet is in your downloads, and the ribbon is on in Class 32.

SHARE THIS ACTIVITY

Pass it on.

XFacebookWhatsApp
PREFER PAPER?

Print the twin.

The same sheet lives in the worksheet library with its download and print buttons: /worksheets/life-skills/help-at-home/. Crayons beat styluses sometimes.

FOR GROWN-UPS

What this sheet practises.

Give your child one real, daily job this week — feeding the pet, pairing the socks — and let the sheet’s drawing be the contract they signed.

  • Helping with chores
  • Matching chores to tools
  • Kind behaviour
  • Word tracing
  • Job confidence

This activity belongs to Class 32 — Life Skills & Good Habits on the Learning Path. Progress is saved on this device for the child chosen in My Classroom — and only a real save of finished work marks it cleared, never just opening the page.
